blocks.text: Legal must issue a written hold notice before any custodian data is collected.
The e-Discovery manager records each custodian acknowledgement, then IT preserves mailbox and drive data. Maintain chain-of-custody logs for every export.
If a custodian is on leave, the manager escalates to Employment Counsel within one business day.

messages.text: Current practice: Legal now sends holds through the case portal; a portal receipt is the written notice evidence.
Please forward the updated custodian list to me when you get a chance — need it for a slide.
FYI — the vendor demo for the new document review platform is Thursday at 2pm; attendance optional.
